report.explanation: All observed checkout requests returned HTTP 200; three of four were 62-78ms and one was 344ms. Traces show successful downstream calls with no errors, and metrics show zero 502s. The single elevated latency is insufficient to establish any bounded root cause from the taxonomy. Healthy telemetry contradicts a fault hypothesis, so hand off for human review rather than assert a cause.
missing_evidence: Baseline latency distribution for /v1/checkout to determine whether 344ms is anomalous versus normal
Sustained latency/error metrics over a longer window to confirm a persistent fault rather than a single slow request
Downstream dependency latency breakdown (order, inventory, payment, postgres, redis) to localize any latency source
Error logs or non-200 responses indicating an actual failure mode
